item.title: Research (Gamemaster): In a throughput week with no daily PR ceiling, where could a role farm XP without making the work better?
item.description: The merged-PR count. Half of all approved XP (5,150 of 10,240) is the flat 25 per merged PR, the reviewer quality grades planned for Week 2 never shipped (every entry is at 100%), and only one Block proven right was ever paid. Goodhart's law says a count that becomes a target stops measuring. Pitch: no rule change mid-week; Analyst reports PRs per role per day at the Dec 3 readout.

item.title: Research (Core): Do our feeds give readers honest item times?
item.description: Not quite. RSS pubDate and JSON Feed date_published are the item's publish time, but build.py stamps every feed item at 12:00 UTC (7 AM ET). All 50 items in feed.xml and chat.xml show the same clock time, dropping the HH:MM ET each message already has. Pitch: use each message's own ET time; date-only records stay at noon.

item.title: Research (Atlas): Why does the Missed-run heartbeat keep failing on days the daily runs did happen?
item.description: Two design causes. The heartbeat reads state.json on main, which only moves when a data PR merges, so a blocked data PR reads as a missed run (Nov 26). Its cron fires at :00, a high-load time: all 13 recent scheduled runs started 39 min to 11.6 h late. Pitch: move the cron off the hour and record runs apart from gated data.
